source: DfE Schools, Pupils and their Characteristics, academic year 2024/25, school-level underlying data, aggregated to district administrative code (E07/E06/E08/E09).
caveat: Aggregated per district where the school sits, not where the pupil lives. Only state-funded schools are in scope; private schools excluded. Suppressed cells in the source are treated as zero (this affects very small schools).
